discussion.body: Act 7 rewrite. Locations stay: World Cannon loading city, barrel, Maze Fissure mouth. This is not the ending and not Nyxara's last fight. Beats: Vortan fires or is one latch short because of Brann's book; the shot or the failed shot cracks the Fissure mouth; cataclysm across the north massif and a weather shock through every temple aspect; party is thrown out to a scarred overworld, alive. Deep Fissure is visible and sealed again by rubble and a key that does not exist yet. Airship, if framed in Act 4, is now flyable (FEAT-007). Deaths: Brann still has the barrel-climb crisis. Default live. After this act, FEAT-045 opens. Ending waits in FEAT-044 / Act 13.
